title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 - Mandatory Grievance Officer Appointment
text: Every e-commerce entity shall appoint a Grievance Officer for consumer grievance redressal and display his name, designation and contact details prominently on its platform.

title: Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021
text: Intermediaries shall acknowledge consumer complaints within 24 hours and resolve them within 15 days of receipt.
source_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
